newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB in talks to buy European bank stake. [CORRECTED 12:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: WestLB in talks to buy European bank stake. [CORRECTED 12:35 GMT]

text.p: Germany's Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale (WestLB) is in talks with European banks with a view to acquiring a stake, its chief executive Friedel Neuber was quoted as saying on Monday.

"We are holding talks at present with European banks about a stake," Neuber, head of the country's biggest publicly-owned bank, told Der Spiegel magazine in an interview. He did not say (corrects from "did say") which banks WestLB was talking to.
"We also want to improve our position in east European business to that we can better accompany German companies there."
The plan to buy a stake in a foreign bank matches a trend towards expansion abroad by Germany's top banks.

Market leader Deutsche Bank AG said recently it was considering buying a French bank while Dresdner Bank AG said it was focusing on the U.S. in search of an acquisition to boost its investment banking business.
Neuber also said recent banking mergers were only the beginning of a wave of concentration in the domestic banking sector.
"We will of course have to think about how to react," Neuber said.

He said WestLB was not in merger talks with other state regional banks, or Landesbanken, in Germany but added: "But we are in principle open to everything. I am sure that recent events have made the Landesbank more ready to talk."

Merger speculation has reached fever pitch since Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG, announced two weeks ago they plan to marry to form Germany's second largest bank.
The public banking sector has also been consolidating, with state-owned Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG and Norddeutsche Landesbank working out plans to merge.
WestLB is unlisted but, with total assets of 444 billion marks ($238.3 billion), is larger than Bayerische Vereinsbank AG, Germany's fourth-biggest listed bank.
It matches the country's top banks not only in size but also in global ambition.

It bought Panmure Gordon, a British stockbroker, and Quorum Capital Management Ltd, a British asset manager, last year and has been expanding its London-based investment banking arm West Merchant Bank Ltd.

Under Neuber's leadership WestLB has acquired the reputation of being a predator, grabbing a share of the tourism market via stakes in tour operator TUI, charter airline LTU and British travel agent Thomas Cook.
-- David Crossland, Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525 ($ = 1.863 German Marks)
